ads.headline: Meta Ads interest at 39/100—window of opportunity before seasonal competition peaks
actions: Launch or scale campaigns for spring service demand (landscaping, window cleaning) before April surge
Test creative variations now while CPMs likely lower than peak season rates
Build audience data and lookalikes this week to have warm audiences ready for higher-budget periods

creative.headline: Unable to provide data-driven recommendations this week
actions: I cannot ethically recommend a specific hook without real performance data — Google Trends shows 0 searches across all your tracked terms, and you've provided no engagement metrics (likes, comments, DMs, shares) from your actual posts

Before filming: Pull your last 7-14 days of Instagram Insights. Screenshot: which Reels got most saves/shares, which got DMs with 'ADS', what was the hook's first 3 seconds, what CTA did you use. Share that data and I'll give you a specific video to film TODAY
Right now you're flying blind — avoid guessing based on vanity metrics (views alone). Focus only on: DM conversion rate and watch-time percentage in first 3 seconds. That's what matters for your goal
creative.source: No actionable data provided. Trend data shows 0 volume. Need: your actual Instagram Insights from this week + DM/engagement data

critic.headline: Meta Ads Not Converting? Check Your Landing Page Speed
actions: Test your landing pages on mobile at 3G speed using Chrome DevTools
In Ads Manager, review Conversion Rate columns and compare by device type
High click costs but low conversion rate = slow pages killing ROI

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
